All 7 tests pass. Here are the 5 bugs fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — used `<=` / `<=` instead of `<` / `<`, causing touching intervals to falsely overlap
2. **`merge_intervals`** — sorted in-place (mutated argument) instead of using `sorted()` to return a new list
3. **`merge_intervals`** — used `<` instead of `<=` for the merge condition, so touching intervals weren't merged
4. **`find_free_slots`** — didn't clamp busy intervals to `[day_start, day_end]`, use `>= min_len`, or handle trailing gap after all busy intervals
5. **`total_busy_minutes`** — summed raw intervals without deduplication; fixed by piping through `merge_intervals()` first
